answer: Rewards can be withheld until an answer passes a similarity check against every other answer in the epoch. Each text becomes a vertex in a graph, with edges linking pairs whose phrasing overlaps beyond chance. Sybil farms leave dense clusters, like a dune built grain by grain from one source, and the whole cluster forfeits its payout. A single honest agent pays nothing, while a fleet repeating one relic template earns zero.
